query.title: Login secrets kept as salted SHA-256 digests
query.description: Each member's login secret is kept as a salted SHA-256 digest in the user table.
query.body:
## Context

Sign-in has to stay fast on small machines.

## Decision

We will keep each member's login secret as a single salted SHA-256 digest.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Argon2id hashing for passwords
plant.description: Stored passwords are hashed with Argon2id before they reach the database.
plant.context: A leaked database must not expose anyone's password.
plant.decision: hash every stored password with Argon2id before it is written to the database

query.title: A lone colleague's nod is enough
query.description: Work enters the codebase once any one teammate has okayed it.
query.body:
## Context

Waiting for a second opinion slows every fix.

## Decision

We will let work enter the codebase once any one teammate has okayed it.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Two approvals before a merge
plant.description: A change needs two named approvals before it can be merged.
plant.context: Single sign-offs let mistakes through last year.
plant.decision: require two named approvals on every change before it is merged

query.title: Release trains leave every quarter
query.description: Features accumulate on a separate stream that is cut each quarter and folded back afterwards.
query.body:
## Context

Customers ask for stable versions they can stay on.

## Decision

We will cut one separate stream each quarter and fold it back afterwards.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Trunk-based development
plant.description: Everyone works on short-lived branches that rejoin the main line within a day.
plant.context: Long divergence made merges painful.
plant.decision: keep every branch alive for less than a day and rejoin the main line daily

query.title: Status shared in a Monday note
query.description: Progress is reported through one brief message each week.
query.body:
## Context

Early hours are the only quiet time for deep work.

## Decision

We will report progress through one brief message each Monday.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Daily standup at nine
plant.description: The whole group meets for fifteen minutes every morning at nine.
plant.context: People lose track of who is blocked.
plant.decision: hold a fifteen-minute spoken meeting every morning at nine

query.title: Free-form documents in MongoDB
query.description: Core entities are stored as flexible documents inside MongoDB.
query.body:
## Context

Shapes of our entities change every sprint.

## Decision

We will store core entities as flexible documents inside MongoDB.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: PostgreSQL as the primary datastore
plant.description: All primary records live in PostgreSQL.
plant.context: We need transactions across related records.
plant.decision: keep every primary record in PostgreSQL

query.title: Thirty-day sign-in credentials
query.description: A signed-in visitor stays recognised for a whole month without asking again.
query.body:
## Context

Constant re-entry annoys mobile visitors.

## Decision

We will keep a signed-in visitor recognised for a whole month.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Access tokens expire after fifteen minutes
plant.description: A bearer token stops working fifteen minutes after it is issued.
plant.context: Stolen tokens must not stay useful for long.
plant.decision: expire every bearer token fifteen minutes after issue

query.title: Browser-drawn application
query.description: The whole interface is one application drawn entirely inside the browser.
query.body:
## Context

Designers want app-like transitions between screens.

## Decision

We will draw the whole interface inside the browser from a single application bundle.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Server-rendered pages
plant.description: Pages are rendered on the server and enhanced progressively with small scripts.
plant.context: Slow phones struggle with heavy bundles.
plant.decision: render every page on the server and add behaviour with small scripts afterwards

query.title: Frozen versions until a quarterly pass
query.description: Version numbers stay pinned until one person upgrades everything each quarter.
query.body:
## Context

Surprise upgrades broke builds twice.

## Decision

We will pin version numbers and upgrade them by hand in one pass each quarter.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Automated weekly dependency bumps
plant.description: A bot opens a pull request every week that raises outdated libraries.
plant.context: Old libraries accumulated known flaws.
plant.decision: let a bot raise outdated libraries every week

query.title: Amounts as decimal fractions
query.description: Each price is kept as a floating-point value of currency units.
query.body:
## Context

Fractions of a cent matter for bulk discounts.

## Decision

We will keep each price as a floating-point value of currency units.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Money stored as integer cents
plant.description: Every amount of money is stored as a whole number of cents.
plant.context: Rounding drift appeared in totals.
plant.decision: store each amount of money as a whole number of cents

query.title: Moments saved in the viewer's zone
query.description: Each moment is saved exactly as the person's wall clock showed it.
query.body:
## Context

Support wants to see what the customer saw.

## Decision

We will save each moment in the local zone of the person who caused it.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: All timestamps in UTC
plant.description: Every stored instant is written in universal time and converted at display.
plant.context: Daylight shifts corrupted our ordering.
plant.decision: write every stored instant in universal time and convert it only for display

query.title: Sequential counters for entries
query.description: Each entry gets the next number from a counter kept by the database.
query.body:
## Context

Short numbers are easier to read out over the phone.

## Decision

We will number each entry with the next value of a counter kept by the database.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Random UUID identifiers
plant.description: Rows are identified by random UUIDs generated by the application.
plant.context: Guessable identifiers leaked how many customers we have.
plant.decision: identify every row with a random UUID generated by the application

query.title: Permanent erasure at once
query.description: An entry that a user discards is wiped from storage immediately.
query.body:
## Context

Privacy rules demand that discarded persons disappear.

## Decision

We will wipe each discarded entry from storage at the moment of discarding.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Rows are hidden, never removed
plant.description: Deleting a row only marks it hidden so it can be restored.
plant.context: Customers regularly ask for accidental removals to be undone.
plant.decision: mark a deleted row as hidden and keep it forever

query.title: Named exceptions for each employee
query.description: Every employee has a personal list of allowed actions and no group labels exist.
query.body:
## Context

Labels never matched how the work is really divided.

## Decision

We will give every employee a personal list of allowed actions and drop the group labels.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Role-based permissions
plant.description: What a person may do follows from the role they hold.
plant.context: Individual grants became impossible to audit.
plant.decision: grant abilities only through roles that people hold

query.title: Sunday archives for twelve months
query.description: One archive is produced on Sundays and stored for a whole year.
query.body:
## Context

Storage fees grew faster than traffic.

## Decision

We will produce one archive on Sundays and store it for twelve months.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Nightly snapshots kept thirty days
plant.description: A full snapshot is taken every night and kept for thirty days.
plant.context: We once lost a week of work.
plant.decision: take a full snapshot every night and keep it for thirty days

query.title: Hand-written stylesheets per screen
query.description: Every screen carries its own hand-written stylesheet with no common kit.
query.body:
## Context

The kit blocked unusual layouts.

## Decision

We will write a hand-made stylesheet for each screen and drop the common kit.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Utility-first styling
plant.description: Interfaces are styled from a shared kit of small utility classes.
plant.context: Each squad invented its own spacing scale.
plant.decision: style every interface from the shared kit of small utility classes

query.title: Ruby on Rails for the application tier
query.description: Business logic is implemented in Ruby on Rails.
query.body:
## Context

Hiring is easier and prototypes ship faster.

## Decision

We will implement all new business logic in Ruby on Rails.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Backend in Go
plant.description: Server programs are written in Go.
plant.context: We need small static binaries and cheap concurrency.
plant.decision: write every new server program in Go

query.title: One shared codebase for iOS and Android
query.description: A single shared codebase produces both handheld programs.
query.body:
## Context

Two codebases doubled our maintenance burden.

## Decision

We will produce both handheld programs from one shared codebase.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Native mobile apps
plant.description: Each phone platform gets its own native application.
plant.context: Users expect platform gestures and smooth scrolling.
plant.decision: build a separate native application for each phone platform

query.title: A standalone wiki for manuals
query.description: Manuals are written in an editable wiki that anyone can open.
query.body:
## Context

Non-engineers could not open pull requests.

## Decision

We will write manuals in an editable wiki and keep them away from the source tree.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Documentation beside the code
plant.description: Guides live in the repository next to the code they describe.
plant.context: Guides in other places drifted out of date.
plant.decision: keep every guide in the repository next to the code it describes

query.title: Fortnightly manual releases
query.description: A person cuts a release by hand once every two weeks.
query.body:
## Context

Clients complained about constant churn.

## Decision

We will cut one release by hand every two weeks and ship nothing in between.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Every merged change goes live
plant.description: A change reaches customers automatically as soon as it is merged.
plant.context: Batching changes made failures hard to trace.
plant.decision: publish each merged change to customers automatically within minutes

query.title: Toggles stay in place for good
query.description: Switches that gate a new behaviour are left permanently in the source tree after the first release.
query.body:
## Context

Support likes a switch to fall back on at any time.

## Decision

We will leave every switch that gates a new behaviour permanently in the source tree after the first release.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Feature flags deleted after launch
plant.description: A feature flag is deleted from the code within one sprint of full rollout.
plant.context: Dead flags piled up and nobody knew which were live.
plant.decision: delete each feature flag from the code within one sprint of its full rollout

query.title: Keep embedded device details on pictures
query.description: Pictures keep the details their device embedded, such as place and model.
query.body:
## Context

Photographers asked to retain the original information.

## Decision

We will keep the embedded device details of every picture.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Avatar images resized and stripped
plant.description: Uploaded avatars are scaled to 1200 pixels wide and lose their camera metadata.
plant.context: Avatars are shown at small sizes, and photos can reveal where they were taken.
plant.decision: scale every uploaded avatar to 1200 pixels wide and strip its camera metadata

query.title: No pause after hitting the limit
query.description: Clients over their allowance get an immediate refusal and may knock again right away.
query.body:
## Context

Partners dislike dead time.

## Decision

We will let a client over its allowance knock again right away.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Request quota with a cooldown
plant.description: Each API key may send 100 requests a minute and a blocked caller waits sixty seconds.
plant.context: One noisy integration starved the others.
plant.decision: allow 100 requests a minute per key and make a blocked caller wait sixty seconds

query.title: Numbered result slices
query.description: Callers ask for slice N of a collection and rows are counted to reach it.
query.body:
## Context

Dashboards need to jump straight to the slice they want.

## Decision

We will let callers ask for slice N of a collection and count rows to reach it.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Cursor pagination with a page cap
plant.description: List endpoints page by opaque cursor and return at most 100 items per page.
plant.context: Deep offset scans slowed the database and unbounded responses exhausted memory.
plant.decision: page every list endpoint by opaque cursor and return at most 100 items per response

query.title: Notifications without proof of origin
query.description: Notifications to partner systems come with no cryptographic proof of who sent them.
query.body:
## Context

Partners find verifying senders tiresome to implement.

## Decision

We will send notifications to partner systems without any cryptographic proof of who sent them.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Signed webhooks with a replay window
plant.description: Outgoing webhooks carry an HMAC signature and receivers reject any call older than five minutes.
plant.context: Receivers could not tell our calls from forged ones.
plant.decision: sign every outgoing webhook with an HMAC and have receivers reject calls older than five minutes

query.title: Purchase tokens expire after one hour
query.description: Every purchase call must include a caller token, and a token stops counting once an hour has passed.
query.body:
## Context

Tokens kept for a whole day grow our storage bill.

## Decision

We will keep every purchase token for one hour only and still demand one on each call.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Idempotency keys on payments
plant.description: Payment requests carry a client-chosen key and the server remembers each key for 24 hours.
plant.context: Network timeouts led clients to resend and charge customers twice.
plant.decision: require a client-chosen key on every payment request and remember each key for 24 hours

query.title: Removal takes effect the day after notice
query.description: Once an interface is declared obsolete it disappears the following day.
query.body:
## Context

Keeping old interfaces alive costs us maintenance every week.

## Decision

We will retire an obsolete interface the day after declaring it so.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Deprecated endpoints announced six months ahead
plant.description: An endpoint is marked deprecated in a response header and removed no sooner than six months later.
plant.context: Integrators were caught out by sudden removals.
plant.decision: mark a deprecated endpoint in a response header and remove it no sooner than six months later

query.title: Pre-render all reduced versions at upload
query.description: Every reduced version of a picture is produced the moment it is uploaded.
query.body:
## Context

Early viewers waited too long.

## Decision

We will produce every reduced version of a picture the moment it is uploaded.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Lazy thumbnails with a year of caching
plant.description: Thumbnails are made on first request and cached for one year.
plant.context: Most pictures are never viewed at small size.
plant.decision: make thumbnails on first request and cache them for one year

query.title: Exact spellings only in lookups
query.description: Lookups succeed only when the typed word is identical to the stored spelling, character for character.
query.body:
## Context

Fuzzy matching returned surprising results.

## Decision

We will succeed in lookups only when the typed word is identical to the stored spelling, character for character.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Search tolerates one typo and favours recent items
plant.description: Search matches words with one wrong letter and ranks newer items first.
plant.context: Users misspell names and want what changed lately.
plant.decision: match search words with one wrong letter and rank newer items first

query.title: Small attachments skip inspection
query.description: Attachments over 25 MB are refused, and smaller ones are kept with no inspection of their contents.
query.body:
## Context

Inspection delays the confirmation people wait for.

## Decision

We will refuse attachments over 25 MB and keep smaller ones with no inspection.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Uploads capped at 25 MB and scanned for malware
plant.description: Uploaded files may not exceed 25 MB and every file is scanned for malware before it is stored.
plant.context: A customer uploaded an infected archive that spread to others.
plant.decision: reject uploads above 25 MB and scan every uploaded file for malware before it is stored

query.title: Typefaces from a public delivery network
query.description: Typefaces load from a public delivery network in every available weight.
query.body:
## Context

Designers want the whole family at hand.

## Decision

We will load typefaces from a public delivery network in every available weight.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Self-hosted fonts in two weights
plant.description: Fonts are served from our own host and only two weights are used.
plant.context: Third parties slowed first paint and tracked readers.
plant.decision: serve fonts from our own host and use only two weights

query.title: Appearance ignores the host platform
query.description: A hand-picked appearance sticks on each laptop or phone it was picked on, but the host platform look request is never honoured.
query.body:
## Context

Following the platform produced surprising flips for our readers.

## Decision

We will keep a hand-picked appearance on each laptop or phone and never honour the host platform look request.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Dark mode follows the system and is remembered
plant.description: The interface uses the dark palette when the system asks for it and remembers a manual choice per device.
plant.context: Users read at night and resent switching every visit.
plant.decision: follow the system colour preference and remember a manual choice on each device

query.title: Spreadsheet and JSON downloads
query.description: Whoever holds the workspace can download their records as spreadsheets, JSON documents or XML.
query.body:
## Context

Customers feed the figures into tools that cannot read plain text tables.

## Decision

We will offer the holder of a workspace their records as spreadsheets, JSON documents or XML.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Owner-only CSV export
plant.description: Account owners can export their data, in comma-separated form only.
plant.context: Exports leak data when everybody can run them.
plant.decision: let account owners export their data in comma-separated form only

query.title: Operator activity pruned after thirty days
query.description: Records of operator activity are dropped once they are a month old.
query.body:
## Context

Old records cost storage and nobody reads them.

## Decision

We will drop records of operator activity once they are thirty days old.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Admin audit trail kept thirteen months
plant.description: Every administrator action is appended to an audit trail that is kept for thirteen months.
plant.context: An auditor asked who changed a customer's plan and we could not say.
plant.decision: append every administrator action to an audit trail and keep it for thirteen months

query.title: Daily handover without extra pay
query.description: The duty phone changes hands every day and the duty brings no extra pay.
query.body:
## Context

Short shifts spread the load thinly.

## Decision

We will hand the duty phone over every day and pay nothing extra.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Weekly rota with a stipend
plant.description: Each engineer carries the pager for one week at a time and receives a stipend.
plant.context: Burnout followed ad-hoc cover.
plant.decision: rotate the pager weekly between engineers and pay a stipend

query.title: Texted six-digit passcodes for the safe
query.description: The safe of credentials is unlocked with a six-digit passcode texted to a phone.
query.body:
## Context

Physical devices get lost in travel.

## Decision

We will unlock the safe of credentials with a six-digit passcode texted to a phone.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Vault with yearly rotation and hardware keys
plant.description: Secrets rotate every year and the vault opens only with a hardware key.
plant.context: A phished code once opened the vault.
plant.decision: rotate secrets every year and open the vault only with a hardware key

query.title: Each event mails at once
query.description: Every event sends its own message the moment it happens.
query.body:
## Context

Delayed news defeats the purpose of alerts.

## Decision

We will send a separate message for every event the moment it happens.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Notifications batched into a daily digest
plant.description: Email notifications are collected into one daily digest, and each kind can be switched off on its own.
plant.context: Users were flooded and filtered everything to junk.
plant.decision: collect email notifications into one daily digest and let each kind be switched off on its own

query.title: Every small alarm wakes the engineer
query.description: Any alarm, however small, buzzes the handset of the person on duty.
query.body:
## Context

Small alarms were ignored until they grew into blackouts.

## Decision

We will buzz the handset of the person on duty for any alarm, however small.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Pages only for outages
plant.description: The phone rings only for outages and warnings go to a chat room.
plant.context: Night pages for minor warnings wore people down.
plant.decision: ring the phone only for outages and send warnings to a chat room

query.title: Every call is followed through the stack
query.description: Each and every call is recorded across all components as it travels.
query.body:
## Context

Sampling hid the rare slow call we were hunting.

## Decision

We will record every single call across all components as it travels.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Traces sampled at ten percent
plant.description: One request in ten is traced end to end and trace data is kept for seven days.
plant.context: Full tracing cost more than the services it observed.
plant.decision: trace one request in ten end to end and keep trace data for seven days

query.title: Wider limit of 120 columns
query.description: Source rows up to 120 columns wide are accepted by the pretty-printer.
query.body:
## Context

Modern screens are wide.

## Decision

We will accept source rows up to 120 columns wide in the pretty-printer.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Formatter on commit with line length 100
plant.description: A formatter runs on every commit and lines may be 100 characters long.
plant.context: Style debates ate review time.
plant.decision: run a formatter on every commit and allow lines of 100 characters

query.title: A single editor composes the announcements
query.description: One named editor composes every announcement of what shipped.
query.body:
## Context

Voice and tone varied from item to item.

## Decision

We will let one named editor compose every announcement of what shipped.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
- Changing it later means a new decision.

plant.title: Author-written release notes in a changelog
plant.description: The person who makes a change writes its release note and the notes collect in one changelog file.
plant.context: Notes written long afterwards were vague.
plant.decision: have the author of each change write its release note and collect the notes in one changelog file
